summary: Lower generic for...of through the JavaScript iterator protocol rather than C# IEnumerable assumptions.

target.notes: Acquires the iterator once, repeatedly calls next with no arguments, applies ToBoolean to done, reads value, executes binding/body, and performs IteratorClose for abrupt exits that leave the loop.

caveats: C# foreach may use different method discovery, exception/disposal precedence, and cannot model arbitrary JS iterator objects or Proxy hooks.

tests.name: custom iterable order
tests.input: const x={*[Symbol.iterator](){yield 3;yield 4}}; let s=""; for(const v of x)s+=v; console.log(s);
